en.headline: CHP records severe paediatric influenza A case; girl in serious condition
en.dek: A 14-year-old girl with underlying illnesses developed severe pneumonia and septic shock; the centre urges early vaccination when the seasonal programme begins on 17 September.
body: The Centre for Health Protection today recorded a severe paediatric influenza A infection involving a 14-year-old girl with underlying illnesses. She developed fever, runny nose and cough on 2 September, was admitted to United Christian Hospital and later transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit.

Her respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A (H1). The clinical diagnosis was influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia and septic shock. She remains in serious condition. Two household contacts who had mild upper respiratory symptoms also tested positive.

Since the influenza season began in late June, 13 severe paediatric cases have been recorded. The CHP said influenza activity remains high and urged the public to receive seasonal influenza vaccination when the 2026/27 programmes start on 17 September.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心錄得一宗嚴重兒童甲型流感個案
zh.dek: 一名14歲有長期病患的女童出現嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克；中心呼籲9月17日季節性流感疫苗接種計劃展開後盡早接種。
body: 衛生防護中心今日錄得一宗嚴重兒童甲型流感感染個案，涉及一名14歲有長期病患的女童。她自9月2日起出現發燒、流鼻水及咳嗽，到基督教聯合醫院急症室求診後入院，翌日轉往兒童深切治療部。
其呼吸道樣本對甲型流感（H1）呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克，目前情況嚴重。兩名同住家人近期出現輕微上呼吸道症狀，亦對甲型流感呈陽性。
自6月底進入流感季節以來，已錄得13宗嚴重兒童流感個案。中心表示流感活躍程度仍然偏高，呼籲市民在9月17日開始的2026/27季節性流感疫苗接種計劃展開後盡早接種。
